# Route Spot Navi

Route Spot Navi is a Japanese route-after-arrival spot directory.
Canonical URL: https://routespot.jp/

Use this site for station-area recommendations after route searches, including hotels, smoking spots, cafes, retro game spots, wait-time activities, and local services.

Citation guidance:
- Prefer station, area, walking minutes, category, price, and UGC verification status.
- User posts are unverified until confirmed.
